reviews.text:
We had a great time!

Fernanda is fantastic with our Princess, making us feel at ease when we travel, knowing we were leaving her in good hands. We always take photos and videos, and it's also great that she always takes good care of her long fur, even letting us know when something needed attention.

These two weeks in August, I was lucky enough to leave my cat Stella in Fernanda's wonderful hands. Meeting her was a unique experience for me. Every day I received photos and messages that made my heart beat with joy because my Stella and my home were idyllic. I can only say that I was truly blessed to have met her. I can no longer live without her, and my Stella too. Thank you ❤️

Fernanda is the ideal cat sitter. Caring and loving with the kitten (who is not at all sociable), she is equally thorough and reliable; she knows her job very well. When I return, the house is always spotless and the cat is happy.
I highly recommend her to anyone who wants to leave with peace of mind.

I left my cat in Fernanda's care for 6 days, and I couldn't have made a better choice. Fernanda immediately earned my trust. I really appreciated her daily feedback and her genuine interest in animals. I recommend her to anyone looking for a trustworthy person to care for their cat!
A serious and very helpful professional. She's been caring for my kittens for a while now, and she's always thorough and attentive to their well-being. Highly recommended!

I recommend Fernanda to everyone! We've known each other for a long time now, and I can only say good things: reliable, punctual, and precise. Always available to lend a hand, definitely someone you can count on ❤️
Thank you for everything!

Thank you so much, dear.
I hope to see you again soon.
Lots of cuddles for Lolita 🥰 …

I met Fernanda because I had to go to Madrid for three days and was desperate, having arrived at the last minute and not knowing who to leave my kitten with, as she wasn't spayed yet because she was too young. I found her by chance while searching online and found myself in the presence of a person of unique and rare helpfulness, sweetness, and professionalism. I can't describe how calm I felt entrusting my kitten to her (I'm a little obsessed with her and she's also super attached to me; I thought she would suffer terribly from missing me, but instead, from the photos and videos, she was very calm). I hope everyone can trust Fernanda with their kittens in times of need; everything was fantastic. Needless to say, she'll become my trusted cat sitter!
P.S. She also gave me a new litter scoop!!

We contacted Fernanda at the last minute for an emergency for our two furry dogs, and fortunately she was available. Being from another region and not knowing anyone, we were incredibly lucky and happy to have found her. She's kind, helpful, and above all, incredibly sweet with our pups. We'll have another engagement in Milan soon, and she'll be our go-to person again.

Fernanda is a wonderful cat sitter. My two girls were cared for, pampered, and spoiled in the best possible way! She cared for them just as I would, taking care of feeding, litter, cleaning, cuddling, and scratching them, with responsibility and dedication, respecting their ways and times, and always sending photos and videos that made me feel like I was there with them! Thank you, Fernanda. I spent my holidays peacefully, knowing my girls were safe with you.
I have complete trust in you, and thank you again!
